text.en: This Order may be cited as the Emergency (Evidence Act) Citation and (Amendment) Order, 1987 and shall come into force on 1st December, Commence1987. ment.

The Evidence Act (Cap. 108) is amended by repealing Sections 25 Repealing of and 26. Sections 25 and 26. Made this 11th day of November, 1987 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
